detail.longDescription:
zerotap is a fast, lightweight AI assistant built for Android. Ask anything, get instant answers, and let AI agent the thinking for you.

No switching between apps, no copy-pasting into browsers — just open zerotap and ask.

💡Ask anything — zerotap understands

zerotap is ready to help with whatever you need:
	- "Find me the best-rated Italian restaurants nearby"
	- "Add a dentist appointment on Thursday at 3pm"
	- "What's the weather like this weekend?"
	- "Write a polite reply to my landlord about the broken heater"
	- "Give me a 5-day meal plan under 2000 calories"
	- "Translate this paragraph to Spanish"

Just type naturally. zerotap understands context, follows up on your questions, and gives clear, useful answers.

🔍 Search the web, manage your day

zerotap can search the internet for up-to-date information, add events to your calendar, check the weather, and more — all from a single conversation. No need to jump between apps.

🧠 Powered by advanced AI

zerotap uses state-of-the-art language models to understand your requests the way a human would. No rigid commands, no keywords to memorise — just a natural conversation.

⚡ Designed for speed

zerotap is built to be fast and lightweight. It launches instantly, responds quickly, and stays out of your way when you don't need it. No bloat, no clutter — just a clean, focused experience.

🔑 Bring your own API key

Use your own AI provider key for full control over costs and model selection. Or subscribe for a hassle-free, all-included experience.

🔐 Privacy first

Your conversations are processed in real time and immediately discarded. We do not store or retain your data, unless you explicitly choose to share it as part of a bug report or feedback.

zerotap — just ask.

Take control. Type it. Done.
https://zerotap.app
